name: Golem, Cannonade
body:
Cannonade Golem
CR 17

This collection of jagged metal rears up into a humanoid form, its enormous cannon tracking movement with mechanical precision.

XP 102,400
N Gargantuan construct
Init +6; Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +2

DEFENSE

AC 34, touch 12, flat-footed 28 (+6 Dex, +22 natural, -4 size)
hp 170 (20d10+60)
Fort +6 Ref +12 Will +8
DR 15/adamantine; Immune construct traits, magic

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee 2 slams +34 (8d6+18)
Ranged cannon +22/+17 (12d6+6/19-20/x4)
Space 20 ft.; Reach 20 ft.
Special Attacks cannon

STATISTICS

Str 46, Dex 22, Con —, Int —, Wis 15, Cha 2
Base Atk +20; CMB +42; CMD 58
Feats Improved Critical (cannon)B
SQ alloyed, blasting critical, gun training

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Alloyed (Ex)

A cannonade golem’s slam and cannon attacks count as adamantine, cold iron, and silver for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction.

Blasting Critical (Ex)

When a cannonade golem confirms a critical hit with a slam attack, it can make one cannon attack against that target as a free action (as long as the cannon is loaded).

Cannon (Ex)

The golem’s cannon has a range increment of 100 feet and deals 12d6 points of bludgeoning and piercing damage on a hit with a x4 critical modifier. Attacks against targets within 100 feet are ranged touch attacks.

The cannon’s magazine can hold up to 20 cannonballs at a time—reloading a single cannonball into this magazine is a standard action for the golem, while loading a cannonball into the cannon itself to fire it is a swift action; this allows the golem to take two shots per round with the cannon.

Cannonade (Ex)

The golem shoots a cannon blast that fills a 60-foot line or a 15-foot cone, dealing 12d6+6 bludgeoning damage (DC 26 Reflex half ). Creatures failing their save are also knocked prone (or pushed 1d4 x 10 feet away, if flying or swimming). Firing a cannonade consumes 3 cannonballs. The save DC is Dexterity-based.

Gun Training (Ex)

A cannonade golem adds its Dex modifier to the damage dealt by its cannon.

Immunity to Magic (Ex)

A cannonade golem is immune to spells and spell-like abilities that allow spell resistance. Certain spells and effects function differently against it, as noted below.

Any spell with the water descriptor that affects a cannonade golem renders its cannon unusable for 1 round (no save).
A heat metal spell causes the golem’s cannon to instantly backfire, dealing 6d6 points of damage to the golem and staggering it for 1 round (no save).

ECOLOGY

Environment any land
Organization solitary or pair
Treasure none

A cannonade golem is a technomagical construct enchanted into a massive heap of jagged metal in a humanoid form, its enormous cannon tracking movement with mechanical precision. A cannonade golem’s internal workings are a mechanical labyrinth; its extradimensional pockets constantly process new black powder to fire its arcane weapon. A cannonade golem stands 25 feet tall and weighs around 30 tons.
